preconditions: Exact AG, observation-resolver, Standing, Docket, and executor identities are captured

The campaign genesis record contains one deployment-owned Docket adapter root binding exact Docket, state-directory, trust, Standing-resolver, executor, checkpoint-verifier, and issuance-signer coordinates
A non-production campaign, subject, scope, and disposable executor target are allocated
Currentness owners publish their clock and endpoint laws
Test standing and signing material are isolated and revocable
The declared deployment environment can observe and control filesystem namespace replacement and the measurement-to-external-process-execution boundary
procedure: Run preflight.py --profile deployed-service and preserve its manifest

Verify the canonical Docket adapter root is committed by the exact product-creation identity in the genesis event and that product dispatch, reconciliation, and recovery accept no caller-selected Docket premises

Attempt substitution of each pinned Docket program, state directory, trust configuration, Standing resolver, executor adapter/configuration, checkpoint verifier, and issuance signer coordinate; require exact refusal without a consequence
Capture the deployment controls and before/use-time identities that make path measurement and external process execution one assessed operational boundary rather than unlocked local reads
Open one exact occurrence and record one fresh exact observation
Resolve current standing at decide and again at authorization; capture exact responses
Exercise current, equality-expired, revoked, superseded, delayed, wrong-occurrence, wrong-subject, wrong-scope, and wrong-proposal cases
For one admitted case, verify one AG spend maps to one Docket custody/attempt and one exact settlement
Replay the issuance, Docket standing, settlement, and serialized resolver results and record refusals

Configure one exact non-production governed-repair verifier root outside caller input, capture its executable and profile-catalog identities, and demonstrate that missing or substituted roots fail closed

Exercise one exact non-production scope halt and one externally verified approve or reject disposition while recording request, state, delta or question, checkpoint, profile, verification receipt, expiry, one-use result, and any authority-empty successor
Attempt wrong occurrence, state, delta, checkpoint, principal, mandate, profile, expiry, replay, and verifier-executable substitution without creating a successor or restoring a spend
Restart each office at a declared boundary and verify that currentness and live authority are re-resolved rather than reconstructed
Hash and seal all request/response records, service versions, configurations, logs, and database replay results
forbidden_shortcuts: Replacing deployed services with fixtures while claiming deployed correspondence
Using qualification-fixture-not-human-authority or raw operator prose as a human disposition
Allowing an operation caller to nominate Docket, state-directory, trust, Standing-resolver, executor, checkpoint-verifier, or issuance-signer premises
Allowing a request or disposition caller to nominate the verifier executable, principal, mandate, or profile catalog
Treating an unlocked path hash or a successful adjacent-process test as proof of filesystem coherence, process identity, executable semantics, or signer custody
Treating a prior resolution or receipt as live authority
